root_cause: Although canonical Powerhouse scheduled content and provider metric collectors were already active, the company LinkedIn/Blog content generator consumed only PROVEN formal social_learnings (none mature), while incoming real social_metric_snapshots were not translated into a bounded next-post creative test. A successful scheduler did not provide an executable learning-to-content handoff.

observed_evidence.formal_social_learning: 23 historical evaluations with no new mature brand tests; 0 commercial verified orders
observed_evidence.post_metrics: Provider LinkedIn company reports limited impression/analytics scope; do not infer zeros or share personal account snapshots
observed_evidence.owner: powerhouse-content-orchestrator and existing protected social publisher

fix: Read only exact owned company post IDs and latest provider snapshots (bounded 24 posts/100 observations) inside existing hourly canonical generator, require two comparable independent mature posts and at least 200 verified cumulative exposure; suggest one counterfactual-backed reversible creative test in the actual AI prompt and persist source decision in the same content artifact. Do not assign an experimental winner or bypass release and provider guardrails.
prevention_rule: Unverified/reactions-only and cross-tenant snapshots are NOT suitable denominators; no inference of causality, zero audience or sales. New creative component follows existing one writer, protected release, exact post provider readback, 24/48/72h measurement and attribution. Missing data becomes explicit SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or WAIT_FOR_COMPARABLE_PROVIDER_METRICS.
terminal_rule: Exact-HEAD Required/CodeQL + protected merge + active Edge function source; then a real next approved company post generated with observed same-platform source and later provider 24/48/72h metrics and paid-order readback for a verified commercial improvement.
